settings.heading: Zavelyn Foot Sleeve's dual-action system: blood flow restoration + multi-directional support
settings.text: After 4 weeks, heel pain shifts from inflammation to tissue breakdown—that's why ice, stretches, and anti-inflammatories stop working. Your tissue is starved of blood and tearing with every step, creating a cycle that never ends.
settings.cta_line: Discover how Zavelyn technology breaks this cycle. ↓
settings.item_1_text: No other sleeve has ever done this—lifts the burden off compromised tissue so it can stop the constant tearing and finally recover. That same support helps prevent discomfort from coming back.
settings.item_2_text: Drives blood deep into tissue that's been starved for months, delivering oxygen and nutrients that kickstart and accelerate natural recovery.
settings.item_3_text: Works continuously while you move, not just when you're resting. Your feet get constant blood flow and support whether you're at work, running errands, or staying active, so recovery happens during your real life.
settings.item_4_text: Feel the difference the moment you put them on as support immediately lifts the burden off damaged tissue. This isn't numbing or masking, it's real structural support doing what compromised tissue can't.
settings.item_5_text: After recovery, wear them strategically on demanding days to keep tissue supported and blood flowing. This prevents you from slipping back into the breakdown cycle, keeping discomfort away for good.

settings.day_1_title: Your Foot Tissues Are Instantly Supported
settings.day_1_text: Your foot tissues are degenerating. Breaking down with every unsupported step. The polyaxial support straps are designed to lock around your arch and help hold those tissues in place, helping take the load off immediately. Many feel relief within hours.
settings.day_1_quote: “2 hours later, the relief was remarkable.”
settings.day_2_title: Those Dreaded Morning Steps Start to Fade
settings.day_2_text: With the straps helping guard against further degeneration, your body starts recovering. By supporting healthy circulation, nutrients can reach the weakened tissue so it can begin to rebuild. Morning pain softens because the tissues aren’t re-tearing overnight anymore.
settings.day_2_quote: “By day 4, I walked to the bathroom without wincing for the first time in 8 months.”
settings.day_3_title: Moving Through Your Day With Confidence
settings.day_3_text: The degeneration cycle is interrupted. Tissues are supported to get stronger, not weaker. Grocery runs, full shifts, school pickups. Things that felt impossible start feeling normal.
settings.day_3_quote: “I made it through my entire 12-hour nursing shift. Haven't done that in over a year.”
settings.day_4_title: The Activities You Gave Up Come Back
settings.day_4_text: Not just less pain, but more life. Playing with your kids, evening walks, vacations on your feet all day. Your tissues have had real time to recover and strengthen. You forget you're even wearing it.
settings.day_4_quote: “I survived 2 weeks of Disney World with my grandkids, on my feet all day.”
settings.day_5_title: Wake Up. Step Down. No Pain.
settings.day_5_text: Thousands of customers report waking up and feeling nothing. No stabbing. No limping. The degenerative spiral is interrupted, tissue is supported, and your arch holds its natural position.
settings.day_5_quote: “I went from not being able to walk to the kitchen to running again. Best money I ever spent.”
